product_desc: Micro-ATX Motherboard supporting 4th Generation Intel Core processors for LGA 1150 socket.

product_features.USB Ports: Rear: 4x USB 3.0, 2x USB 2.0; Internal Headers: 1x USB 3.0 (for 2 ports), 2x USB 2.0 (for 4 ports)
product_features.Cooling Features: 1x CPU Fan connector, 2x System Fan connectors
product_features.BIOS Features: Click BIOS 4, M-Flash, Fast Boot, OC Genie 4
product_features.Expansion Headers: 24-pin ATX power, 4-pin ATX 12V power, Clear CMOS jumper, Serial port, TPM header, Front Panel Audio, Chassis Intrusion
